patch_description: Add a 3-cycle rotation move to local_search(): after single-model moves and pairwise swaps fail, pick the three hottest GPUs and try cyclic rotations of the form (A from hot → g1, B from g1 → g2, C from g2 → hot). Each move is applied tentatively with feasibility checks and accepted only if the new max KVPR strictly decreases. This extends the neighborhood beyond 1-opt moves and 2-swaps, helping escape local minima, and stacks with the existing refine+ILS framework.
